```rust
fn render_table_row(
    cells: &[String],
    widths: &[usize],
    aligns: &[Alignment],
    style: RStyle,
) -> Option<Line<'static>> {
    if cells.is_empty() {
        return None;
    }
    let mut spans = vec![Span::styled(" ", style)];  // leading space
    for (i, width) in widths.iter().enumerate() {
        if i > 0 {
            spans.push(Span::styled(" ", style));  // inner separator space
        }
        let cell = cells.get(i).map(String::as_str).unwrap_or("");
        let aligned = align_cell(
            cell,
            *width,
            aligns.get(i).copied().unwrap_or(Alignment::Left),
        );
        spans.push(Span::styled(aligned, style));
    }
    spans.push(Span::styled(" ", style));  // trailing space
    Some(Line::from(spans))
}
```

```rust
fn base64_decode(input: &str) -> String {
    fn value(c: char) -> u32 {
        match c {
            'A'..='Z' => (c as u32 - 'A' as u32),
            'a'..='z' => (c as u32 - 'a' as u32 + 26),
            '0'..='9' => (c as u32 - '0' as u32 + 52),
            '+' => 62,
            '/' => 63,
            _ => 0, // '=' or anything else treated as padding/no-op
        }
    }
    let mut out: Vec<u8> = Vec::new();
    let mut buf: u32 = 0;
    let mut bits: u32 = 0;
    for c in input.chars().filter(|c| **c != '=') {
        let v = value(c);
        buf = (buf << 6) | v;
        bits += 6;
        if bits >= 8 {
            bits -= 8;
            out.push(((buf >> bits) & 0xff) as u8);
        }
    }
    out.into_iter().map(char::from).collect()
}
```

```rust
fn base64_decode(input: &str) -> String {
    const TABLE: &str = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/";
    let vals: Vec<u32> = input
        .bytes()
        .filter(|&b| b != b'=' && b != b'\n' && b != b'\r')
        .map(|b| {
            TABLE
                .find(b as char)
                .map(|i| i as u32)
                .expect("non-base64 character in escape")
        })
        .collect();
    let mut out: Vec<u8> = Vec::new();
    for group in vals.chunks(4) {
        let len = group.len();
        // Place each present char in its fixed 6-bit slot (char 0 -> bits 18-23,
        // then 12-17, 6-11) with missing slots zeroed, exactly mirroring the
        // encoder's full 24-bit groups. A trailing partial group then decodes to
        // the correct bytes; a fixed shift keyed on `len` would get this wrong.
        let n: u32 = match len {
            4 => (group[0] << 18) | (group[1] << 12) | (group[2] << 6) | group[3],
            3 => (group[0] << 18) | (group[1] << 12) | (group[2] << 6),
            2 => (group[0] << 18) | (group[1] << 12),
            _ => 0,
        };
        match len {
            4 => {
                out.push((n >> 16) as u8);
                out.push((n >> 8) as u8);
                out.push(n as u8);
            }
            3 => {
                out.push((n >> 16) as u8);
                out.push((n >> 8) as u8);
            }
            2 => out.push((n >> 16) as u8),
            _ => {}
        }
    }
    String::from_utf8(out).expect("base64 payload is utf-8")
}
```
